lines.zh: 我的骨架在下界的火里响。
lines.en: My frame creaks in the Nether's fire.
I walk straighter than my kin.
Flame runs along my spine.

lines.zh: 我一脚踩碎焦黑的岩石。
lines.en: My foot crushes blackened rock.
I don't avoid lava; I step across it.
Firelight fills every seam of my armor.
I turn and sparks scatter.
My steps fall heavy as a bell.
I cross the burning waste.
I raise a hand, knuckles pale.
I'm looking for something to burn.
Ash kicks up around my feet.
I stand, fire circling me.

lines.zh: 我的胸腔里有东西在烧。
lines.en: Something burns inside my chest.
I don't blink.
The Nether sky is dull red.
The fire follows my gesture.

lines.zh: 我在等一个召唤的时机。
lines.en: I wait for the moment to summon.

lines.zh: 这里的石头已经被我烤裂。
lines.en: I've baked the stone here until it split.
I listen to the distance.
I smell the iron you carry.
I study you without expression.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，杀过不少恶魔吧？
lines.en: That thing in your hands has killed demons, hasn't it?

lines.zh: 你不退，我就多看你一会。
lines.en: If you don't back off, I'll watch a while longer.
Your armor won't stop fire.

lines.zh: 你身上的热气在往外冒。
lines.en: Heat is pouring off you.
You stand steady. A pity it won't help.
You carry a fire I have already lit.
My frame groans.
The flame gutters for a moment.
Smoke rises from the wound.
A crack opens in my armor.
My fire burns hotter.
Your firepower is decent.
Not enough, though.

lines.zh: 我的火焰被压下去了一点。
lines.en: My flames are pressed down, but only a little.
You'd buy me with that?
That's not what I want.

lines.zh: 把它丢进火里，我就看一眼。
lines.en: Throw it in the fire and I'll take a look.
That won't burn long.
I reach out only in passing.
Your hand is pulling back.
Mortal things are all firewood.
I'm taking it.
Step aside. Don't block the flames.
You're next.
You hit me and leap back from the burn.
I don't even turn my head.
My armor is hot.
That cost you.
You retreat quickly.
Don't touch what's burning.
You'll try again.
Next time it won't just be heat.
Eternal fire has no need to breed.
There are fewer of us now.
I raise a hand and nothing comes.
The Nether's fire answers for me.
I stand and listen to it burn.
The sound goes on a long time.
I don't feel alone.
Fire is enough.
I put my hand back into the fire.
Keep walking.
I pinch it between my fingers.
It burns in my hand.
I don't mind.
Anything burnable, I keep.
I toss it into the fire behind me.
The flame leaps up.
Ash slips between my fingers.
This mote of energy, I draw into my palm.
You've appeared. Then we begin.
A ring of fire spreads from my feet.
My chant is quiet.
Fire gathers behind you.
I've sealed this route.
I'm waiting for that gun of yours.
No hurry to strike you.
First, burn this ground.
Wherever you retreat, I'll burn.
It begins, mortal.
Your time is short.
I don't need to chase you.
I've added fire to this ground.
You have fewer places to step.
I raise a hand and something bursts far off.
You looked back.
A pity. I'm ahead.
Walls of fire on both sides.
You can only go forward.
And my fire is ahead.
I'm waiting for you to tire.
That shot went wide.
The smoke caught you.
Good.
Ten more steps.
That's the end.
My palm falls and a wave of fire pushes out.
A pillar of fire erupts from the ground.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的手臂，皮肉发焦。
lines.en: I seize your arm and the flesh chars.
I shove you into the rock wall.

lines.zh: 我的脚下裂开一道火缝。
lines.en: A burning fissure opens at my feet.
The burn drives you back two steps.
I don't rely on strength.
The fire will stay.
You can't beat out all of it.
Your armor is starting to warp.
I step back and watch it burn.
Next blow, I won't hold back.
Your skin is reddening.
I raise a hand for one more.

lines.zh: 我一脚踩住你，地面发红。
lines.en: I pin you underfoot and the ground glows red.

lines.zh: 火顺着我的手臂缠上你。
lines.en: Fire climbs my arm onto you.
I rise out of the fire.

lines.zh: 火焰在我身上重新点燃。
lines.en: Flame re-lights across my body.

lines.zh: 我的盔甲还带着上一场的焦黑。
lines.en: My armor still bears the last fight's scorch.
Nether air fills my lungs.
I raise a hand and flex it.
The fire answers.
There's something living on this waste.
I smell iron.
Ash settles behind me.
I'll find it.
Then burn it.
Fire only makes me more whole.

lines.zh: 我砸在焦岩上，火星四溅。
lines.en: I crash onto scorched rock, sparks flying.

lines.zh: 水淋下来，我的火嘶嘶作响。
lines.en: Water pours down and my fire hisses.
The blast tears open my curtain of fire.

lines.zh: 一枚弹丸打穿我的肩甲。
lines.en: A round punches through my shoulder plate.

lines.zh: 光压住我的火，我一时动不了。
lines.en: Light presses down my fire and I can't move.
No fuel; my fire is shrinking.
Lightning runs down my frame.
I fall, and the fire is pulled away.
